::: {#def-relation-composition}
#### Composition of relations

Let $R$ be a relation from a set $A$ to a set $B$,
and $Q$ a relation from $B$ to a set $E$ (@def-binary-relation).
The **composition** of $R$ and $Q$ [@wikipedia_composition_of_relations]
is the relation from $A$ to $E$

$$
Q \circ R \eqdef \set{(a, e) \in A \times E : a \mathrel{R} b \text{ and } b \mathrel{Q} e \text{ for some } b \in B}.
$$

The relation used first, $R$, is written on the right.

:::
